drhp.business: Siemens Limited manufactures, trades and distributes Siemens-branded industrial and infrastructure products in India under licence from its parent Siemens AG, producing goods 'local for local' for the domestic market and 'local for global' for export, and also undertaking contract manufacturing for Siemens AG. It leverages Siemens AG's technology, intellectual property, software tools, engineering expertise and standardized risk-management framework, and runs service hubs in India that serve both Indian customers and the wider Siemens Group. sk.overview: Powerica operates across two industries: (1) India's standby power / diesel-generator (DG set) market, where DG sets, UPS, inverters and battery storage provide backup power during outages/voltage fluctuations across commercial, manufacturing, IT/data-centre, telecom and infrastructure sectors (F&S Report); and (2) India's wind power sector within the broader renewable energy industry, where wind plays a pivotal role in the country's energy transition (CRISIL Report).
